# Ting (Vincent) Lu

> Personal website of Ting (Vincent) Lu, who grew up in China and has lived in the Netherlands since 2015. Stories from work and from moving countries, and some notes.

- [Stories](https://vincentluting.github.io/stories/): a few stories from work
- [Blog](https://vincentluting.github.io/posts/): notes
